Berapa lama proses Closed Testing berlan: How long does the Closed Testing process take?
Google mensyaratkan setidaknya 20 tester: Google requires at least 20 active testers for a minimum of 14 days. Our platform helps you reach that target by connecting you with the right testers.
Bagaimana jika tester tidak menyelesaika: What if a tester does not complete the mission?

Bagaimana cara mendapatkan reward sebaga: How do I get rewards as a Tester?
Setelah bergabung ke misi dan menyelesai: After joining a mission and completing all requested steps (downloading the app, opening it, and giving a review on the Play Store), your reward will be processed within 1-3 business days.
Berapa reward yang bisa saya dapatkan pe: How much reward can I get per mission?
Besaran reward bervariasi tergantung jen: The reward amount varies depending on the type of mission and developer. The average reward ranges from Rp 5,000 to Rp 50,000 per mission.

Sebagian besar misi bisa dilakukan di pe: Most missions can be done on Android devices running version 8.0 and above. Some missions may require specific specifications, which will be listed in the mission description.
